basic_profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old high school student living in Austin, Texas. I've always been passionate about technology and recently got into home networking setups. You can usually find me online in the evenings after school, around 6 PM to midnight CST. I enjoy helping my friends with tech issues and exploring new gadgets. My current project involves setting up a smart home system. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my friends on Discord and Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing interest in computer science and technology, which started with building my first PC. I've learned a lot through online tutorials and forums, and I'm currently taking a computer science class at school. I often experiment with different networking setups at home, which has given me practical experience.
